(Gaṇaka)Ballāladaivajña
of Dadhigrāma an. Kāśī; son of Trimalla; father of Kṛṣṇa Daivajña (a. of C. Kalpalatāvatāra on Bījagaṇita of Bhāskarācārya, NCC. IV. p. 323b) an. Raṅganātha (a. of C. Gūḍhārthaprakāśikā on Sūryasiddhānta, IO. 2775); grandfather of Nārāyaṇa Daivajña (a. of C. on Jātakapaddhati of Keśava, NCC. VII. p. 218b) an. Viśvarūpa alias Munīśvara (a. of C. Nisṛṣṭārthadūtī on Līlāvatī of Bhāskara, Mithilā III. 152).
For a. account of his family members see S. B. Dikshit, Bhāratīya Jyotiṣ (Hindi edn.) p.. 389 ff. [Page244-b]
